match.sense: JMdict sequence 1360010 supports an intransitive ichidan verb. Both Japanese sentences use 寝る in the go-to-bed sense, while the German translations assert sleeping or falling asleep.

firstPass.finding: JMdict sequence 1360010 supports an intransitive ichidan verb. Both Japanese sentences use 寝る in the go-to-bed sense, while the German translations assert sleeping or falling asleep.

secondPass.finding: Independent review confirms that the two time-bounded sentences use 寝る as going to bed. Although JMdict also includes the broad sense 'sleep', 十一時に寝ます describes the action of retiring at eleven, whereas German 'Ich schlafe um elf Uhr' describes a state at that time. Likewise, 昨日早く寝ました normally says the speaker went to bed early; it does not specifically assert the onset event 'einschlafen'. The first-pass correction is necessary and semantically more exact.
